node.subject: english
node.title: 讨论与辩论
node.academic_req: 能在讨论或辩论情境中, 就熟悉话题明确表达立场, 用事实或理由支撑观点, 并对不同意见作出礼貌回应。
key_points: 能用 "I agree / I disagree because..." 等结构明确开场表态自己的立场
能在发言结尾用 "In conclusion, I believe..." 复述并总结自己的核心观点
node.assessment_prompt: 辩论「Should students have homework?」，{{name}}能不能用「I  because」开场明确表态？\n听到对方反驳后，{{name}}会不会用「I understand your point, but...」礼貌回应而不是直接说 No？\n辩论结束前，{{name}}会不会用「In conclusion, I believe...」做总结陈词，清晰复述自己的核心观点？

node.common_mistakes: 学生把 I disagree with you 写成 I don't agree you (漏掉 with);学生辩论时忘用 In my opinion 开头直接说观点显得突兀;学生把 Let's discuss about it 写成 L
node.teaching_activity: 用 4 张辩论立场卡 (For/Against/Neutral/Question) 让孩子抽卡分组,每组 4 人计时 5 分钟用 I think.../I disagree.../In my opinion... 句型轮流发言;
node.teaching_voice: 我们来看,讨论和辩论就是用英语亮明观点、说服别人。想象家里你和弟弟抢电视遥控器,你得说'I disagree, because I watched it first',而不是光跺脚。记住,结尾加一句'In conclusion, I believe...'让你的理由更稳。

exercises.question: In a class debate about "Should students be allowed to use phones at school?", which opening sentence best shows a clear stance?
exercises.explanation: B 用 'I agree because...' 明确表态并给出理由,符合开场结构。A 没立场,C 只描述事实,D 与论点无关,都没清晰表态。
options: A. I don't know, maybe phones are useful or maybe not.
B. I agree because phones can help students learn online.
C. Some students like phones and some students don't like them.
D. Phones are very popular in the world today.

exercises.question: Lily is giving a speech to end the debate. She wants to restate her opinion. She says: "____, I believe students should have less homework."
exercises.explanation: 用 'In conclusion' 引导总结句,能复述并强调自己的核心观点,是辩论/演讲结尾的典型结构。

exercises.question: Your classmate says "Exams are bad for students." Do you agree or disagree? Give one reason and write a full short speech with an opening and a conclusion.
exercises.answer: 示例:I disagree because exams help us check what we have learned and prepare us for the future. In conclusion, I believe exams are useful if we take them in the right way.
exercises.explanation: 评分要点:1. 用 'I agree/disagree because...' 明确开场表态并给理由;2. 理由合理、与话题相关;3. 用 'In conclusion, I believe...' 总结复述观点,结构完整。

exercises.question:
Suppose your class is having a debate on the topic "Should students be allowed to use smartphones in class?" You are on the opposing side. The previous speaker just said: "I agree, because smartphones help us look up new words and learn English more efficiently."

Please write your short speech (40-60 words) according to the discussion/debate structure: clearly state your position with "I disagree because...", give ONE main reason, and end with "In conclusion, I believe...".
exercises.answer: I disagree because smartphones in class often distract students. Many classmates would secretly play games or chat with friends instead of listening to the teacher, and this hurts both our study and the classroom atmosphere. Traditional dictionaries and teacher explanations are enough for us to learn new words. In conclusion, I believe smartphones should not be allowed in class.
exercises.explanation:
1. 立场表态: 使用了 "I disagree because..." 明确亮出反对立场。
2. 理由阐述: 给出一条具体理由 (分散注意力/玩游戏聊天), 并补充可行的替代方案 (字典、老师讲解), 体现辩论的说服力。
3. 结尾总结: 使用了 "In conclusion, I believe..." 复述核心观点, 结构完整。

exercises.question:
Your school is holding an English debate on "Is exams the best way to measure students' ability?" Two teams have finished their arguments:
· Pro team: "I agree, because exams give us fair and objective scores, and push us to review what we have learned."
· Con team: "I disagree, because exams only test memory, not real abilities like creativity or teamwork."

As the final speaker, please write a short summary speech (60-90 words) that combines both teams' views. You need to: (1) give your own clear stand with "I agree/disagree because..."; (2) respond to ONE point from the opposite side; (3) end with "In conclusion, I believe..." to restate your core opinion.
exercises.answer: I disagree, because exams are not the best, though not useless way to measure students. I understand the Pro team's point that exams are fair and objective, but a student who is great at art, sports or group work may fail every maths exam and still have strong abilities. Schools should use exams together with projects, presentations and daily performance. In conclusion, I believe exams are useful but should not be the only way to judge a student.
exercises.explanation:
1. 明确表态: 使用 "I disagree, because..." 亮明立场, 并在结尾用 "In conclusion, I believe..." 复述, 体现辩论结构完整。
2. 回应反方: 承认对方 "公平客观" 的合理性 (I understand...), 再反驳其片面性 (艺术/体育/合作能力被忽视), 体现综合评价能力。
3. 提出方案: 给出 "考试+项目+日常表现" 的多维评价建议, 体现跨概念综合 (评价方式 + 真实学习情境), 具备压轴题深度。
